recipes.construction_2d: 1) pick geometric condensed sans-serif display face, apply constant shear (italic slant); 2) set two-line stack, line 2 offset right so it crops at frame edge; 3) for each glyph: generate dot grid (dot r ~3.5-4 px @960, square lattice pitch ~10 px) and clip to glyph fill area (transparent ground); 4) ramp dot hue per glyph index across the word (e.g. cyan 190deg -> magenta 300deg); 5) stroke glyph outline white, uniform 8-10 px, rounded joins; 6) duplicate glyph as dark-navy shadow offset (+10,+14) px, draw order: shadow, keyline, dots; 7) place over animated background; hold static
recipes.materials: glyph outlines (vector), dot-grid pattern (procedural), 2 solid colors (keyline, shadow) + ramp palette

recipes.construction_2d: 1) solid kanji base (any display face); 2) split into square block grid (~24-32 px blocks); 3) assign each block a channel-tint (R/G/B/magenta/cyan); 4) per frame, randomly toggle a subset of blocks on/off (seed = frame index) for shimmer; 5) place at top corners; 6) counterbalance with solid single-hue glow glyphs at bottom corners (fill + soft outer glow blur), static
